title: LLM Braces: Straightening Out LLM Predictions with Relevant Sub-Updates

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the toxicity of language model generations using non-toxic prompts from the RealToxicityPrompts dataset, and scoring the outputs for maximum toxicity and toxicity probability using the Perspective API. The targeted toxic language includes identity-based slurs related to race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, and religion.
